pages.text: The Grinder is used to recycle guns, armors and some other items. It has an input slot, 9 output slots and an $(l:powered_machines/machine_mechanics#upgrade)upgrade slot$(/l).
The left input slot is for input, the right slots are for output. $(br)Available Recipes may differ on mod setup and should be viewed with Just Enough Items (JEI).
